# Hotel Nakshatra & Resort — Khargone, Madhya Pradesh

> Premier luxury resort, hotel, destination wedding venue, banquet hall, and multi-cuisine dining destination in Khargone, Madhya Pradesh.

## Key Facts & Direct Contacts
- **Property Name**: Hotel Nakshatra & Resort
- **Address**: Sanawad Road, Jaitapur, Near D-Mart, Khargone, Madhya Pradesh 451001, India
- **Official Website**: https://www.nakshatrahotel.in
- **24/7 WhatsApp Booking & Rates**: +91 94797 93778 (Direct WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919479793778)
- **Management & Call Desk**: +91 94250 88369 (Direct Call: tel:+919425088369)
- **Number of Rooms**: 60 luxury rooms across Executive, Deluxe, Family, and Luxury Suites
- **Check-in / Check-out**: 12:00 PM / 10:00 AM

## Facilities & Amenities
- **Swimming Pools**: Ground-floor swimming pool for all registered staying guests + exclusive 3rd-floor private pool suites.
- **Wedding & Banquet Venues**: ~5,500 sq ft grand indoor air-conditioned banquet hall + lush open-air wedding garden & celebration lawns.
- **Dining**: Pure vegetarian & multi-cuisine restaurant serving North Indian, Continental, Chinese, and regional specialties.
- **Parking**: Khargone's biggest dedicated on-site parking area with 24/7 security for 200+ vehicles.
- **Connectivity**: High-speed WiFi (50+ Mbps), power backup, 24-hour front desk.

## Nearby Tourism & Pilgrimage Connectivity
- **Near D-Mart, Khargone**: 0.2 km (walking distance on Sanawad Road)
- **Navgraha Mandir, Khargone**: 4 km (10 minutes)
- **Maheshwar Fort & Ahilya Ghat (Narmada River)**: 50 km (1 hour 10 minutes)
- **Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga Temple**: 75 km (1 hour 45 minutes)
- **Khandwa Junction**: 85 km (2 hours)
- **Indore Airport (IDR)**: 95 km (2 hours 15 minutes via NH3)
